product: TomTom Traffic Flow API (Flow Segment Data v4)
historical_analysis: The developer Flow Segment Data API is strictly a real-time current traffic monitoring service. Past dates or arbitrary historical timestamps cannot be queried. Historical data is gated under the commercial TomTom MOVE / Traffic Stats enterprise service.
temporal_resolution: 1-minute real-time update cycle; no historical temporal querying parameter
training_suitability_explanation: Classification B: Suitable for real-time inference, live ETA evaluation, and route monitoring, but NOT sufficient as an on-demand historical time-series training dataset for P3 ML models unless polled continuously into the future.
retention_and_ml_restrictions: Developer evaluation tier permits caching for navigation but restricts permanent bulk storage, redistribution, and competitive model extraction without enterprise agreement.
